name: monthly_surplus
description: Works out how much money is left each month after spending, which is the amount available to save for the wedding.
formula: monthly surplus = net_monthly_income - monthly_spending, rounded to 2 decimals (halves round up). The result is negative if spending is higher than income.

inputs.name: net_monthly_income
inputs.description: Your take-home pay for a typical month, after tax and deductions, in your currency.

inputs.name: monthly_spending
inputs.description: What you spend in a typical month on all your regular costs, in your currency. Leave out the wedding payments. It can be an average.

output.description: The amount left each month after spending, in your currency, rounded to 2 decimals. Negative if you spend more than you earn.
